reviews.comment:
El camping esta al lado de la ruta así que los ruidos son insoportables, si se busca desconectar y relajar no es ni cerca el lugar. El baño lejos pero limpios, único servicio bueno. Wifi no hay, solo en el sector de entrada. La parcela que encontramos al igual que otras no tenía enchufe cerca. Mucha gente.
No vale lo que sale realmente

(Translated by Google)
The campsite is right next to the road, so the noise is unbearable. If you're looking to disconnect and relax, this isn't the place for you. The bathroom is far away but clean—the only good service. There's no Wi-Fi, only in the entrance area. Like others, our pitch didn't have a nearby power outlet. It was very crowded. It's not worth the price.
